description: Run one of this service's tools by name. Costs that tool's own price per successful call (most $0.01; describe_tool and find_tool show it); a failed call costs nothing, and tools marked inFreeCalls (tools that only compute or look up public data; not AI, speech, transcription, images, rendering, search or resold data) run free while the caller has free calls left. Pass the tool's inputs as "arguments". If you do not know the name or the inputs, call find_tool or describe_tool first: a wrong name or a missing input is refused before anything is charged. A tool that costs more than $0.10 a call (find_tool marks it needsMaxPrice) runs only when you pass that price as "max_price"; without it the call is refused, uncharged, and the refusal states the price.

arguments.description: The tool's inputs as an object, for example {"city": "Paris"}. See describe_tool for a tool's inputs

max_price.description: Only for a tool that costs more than $0.10 a call: the most this call may cost, for example "$1.00". Leave it out for every other tool

name.description: The tool's name from find_tool, for example weather_forecast

name: call_tool
title: Run a tool by name
